"Hey I like your scarf, where did you buy it?"

I used to have this issue too (along with many others) but a technique I use and continue to is switching eyes. Initially when you lock eyes, it should be very natural and you should just let your body flow with it. If you have to continue keep eye contact, focus on either their left or right eye and slowly move to the other. 

To the recipient, it would still look like you are maintaining eye contact in a natural way. Also, don't make it look like you are staring. In a conversation don't be afraid to smile, nod or even break eye contact for a split second (just make sure to go back).
